export.title: Export scraped data
export.description: Select a library and export its entire scraped collection or one platform with related assets.
export.nameModeHint: Only the exported display title changes; the separate Chinese-name entry is preserved.
export.targetHint: Defaults to the selected library or platform. Whole-library exports preserve platform subdirectories in another destination.
export.contents: Includes all temporary metadata and related files under the platform media directory.
export.libraryContents: Includes metadata and media for every scraped platform in this library. Platforms without scraped data are skipped.
